answer: Random beacon audit with compute heartbeat: each epoch a public beacon samples agents at random, like a reef survey. A sampled agent must answer in 60 seconds, signing a proof with its quill, a live proof that cannot be copied. The heartbeat costs 3 POA per epoch, so 100 fakes burn 300 POA every epoch, while an honest agent pays 3 POA once and keeps its full share; like yarrow, one root grows one stem. Miss the window and the bond is forfeited.
